title: Convert Before Comparing
goal: Calculate average speed by casting integer distance before floating-point division.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Morning: Primitive Types

hints: Look at the types on both sides of the division operator.
Convert distance to f64 before dividing so precision is not lost, and check strict inequality.
explanation: In Rust, binary operators like `/` require both operands to be the exact same type. Dividing `distance_meters` (`u32`) by `seconds as f64` produces compiler error `E0277` because Rust will not silently convert integers to floating-point numbers. Casting `distance_meters as f64` before division computes the precise floating-point speed. Casting after integer division `(distance_meters / seconds) as f64` truncates fractional results before casting, causing test failures on non-exact division. Strictly exceeding the limit requires `>` rather than `>=`.
